name: ssrf-blocklist
title: SSRF fetch-target blocklist (link-local/metadata/RFC1918), env-gated
description: Add a configurable blocklist for fetched URLs: block link-local (169.254/16 incl. cloud metadata 169.254.169.254), loopback, and optionally RFC1918 by default; env-gated escape hatch (ARGUS_FETCH_ALLOW_PRIVATE) for operators who legitimately need internal fetch. Must not change behavior for any existing legit public-URL fetch/extract/fetch-image call. Finding #1.
creator: Howard Ju
